item.title: HS SWIMMING: Dallas, Tunkhannock split
item.description: Jaden Baltrusaits took first place in the 50 free and 100 free to help Tunkhannock defeat host Dallas, 116-64, on Friday in Wyoming Valley Conference boys swimming. Aidan Mislevy won the 100 back, while Kyle Kozloski won the 100 breast for the Tigers. Blayne Roosa won the diving with a score of 262.50. item.title: AHL: Dumba’s hat trick leads Penguins over Lehigh Valley
item.description: A fast start and strong finish helped propel the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins to another victory over Turnpike rival Lehigh Valley on Friday night at the PPL Center in Allentown. Matt Dumba recorded a hat-trick, scoring one goal in each period in a 6-5 victory over the Phantoms. The Penguins are 6-0-0-1 against Lehigh Valley this season and 31-12-2-2 overall. item.title: Spaying helps prevent cat overpopulation
item.description: Between 100 and 150. That is the estimated number of kittens an unspayed cat can have in her lifetime. ABC Clinic Pet Refuge Animal Birth Control Clinic says in just one year, an unspayed cat who is allowed to roam outdoors can have three litters resulting in 12 kittens. One year later, those 12 kittens if kept unspayed, can have 144 offspring of their own. Such figures illustrate that the potential for feral cat overpopulation is high.
